pages.quiz:
FRENCH — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #8
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: FRENCH
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What number is 'dix-huit' in French? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 7
   C. 31
   D. 8

2. What does 'Le sac est dans la chambre.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. The bag is in the bedroom.
   B. The rug is in front of the sofa.
   C. It is a bed.
   D. It is a table.

3. What does 'Je m'appelle Amina.' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. What is your name?
   B. And you?
   C. How are you?
   D. My name is Amina.

4. How do you write the number 21 in French? (1 mark)
   A. dix-huit
   B. six
   C. cinq
   D. vingt et un

5. What does 'Le dimanche, je me repose.' mean? (1 mark)
   A. Today it is Monday.
   B. On Sunday, I rest.
   C. On Sunday, I go to church.
   D. On Thursday, I sing.

6. How do you say 'sweets' in French? (1 mark)
   A. les bonbons
   B. le thé
   C. la banane
   D. les haricots

7. Which little word goes with 'table' (the table)? (1 mark)
   A. les
   B. le
   C. la
   D. l'

8. What does 'Et toi ?' mean? (1 mark)
   A. Good evening, Madam!
   B. Hi, Kamau!
   C. And you?
   D. What is your name?

9. What does 'bien' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. goodbye
   B. hi, bye
   C. well
   D. Pleased to meet you

10. What does 'la chaise' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the ball
   B. the bedroom
   C. the bag
   D. the chair

11. Fill in: lundi, mardi, ______, jeudi. (1 mark)
   A. dimanche
   B. mercredi
   C. vendredi
   D. samedi

12. What does 'à côté de' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. to the left
   B. next to
   C. to the right
   D. straight ahead

13. How do you say the month 'June' in French? (1 mark)
   A. décembre
   B. octobre
   C. mars
   D. juin

14. What does 'le frigo' mean in English? (1 mark)
   A. the bathroom
   B. the chair
   C. the bed
   D. the fridge

15. Which little word goes with 'tête' (the head)? (1 mark)
   A. la
   B. l'
   C. le
   D. les

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Write the French words for: health, the cake, beans (3 marks) (3 marks)

17. Draw and label a simple bedroom in words: write the French labels for the bed, the door, the window and the chair. (4 marks) (4 marks)

18. Translate into English: 'Le lundi, je vais à l'école.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

19. Translate into French: 'Turn left.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

20. Translate into English: 'Quel temps fait-il ?' (3 marks) (3 marks)
pages.answers:
FRENCH — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #8 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — 18
   dix-huit means 18.

2. A — The bag is in the bedroom.
   Le sac est dans la chambre. means The bag is in the bedroom.

3. D — My name is Amina.
   Je m'appelle Amina. means My name is Amina..

4. D — vingt et un
   21 in French is vingt et un.

5. B — On Sunday, I rest.
   Le dimanche, je me repose. means On Sunday, I rest.

6. A — les bonbons
   sweets in French is les bonbons.

7. C — la
   table is feminine, so we say la table.

8. C — And you?
   Et toi ? means And you?

9. C — well
   bien means well.

10. D — the chair
   la chaise means the chair.

11. B — mercredi
   Wednesday comes between Tuesday and Thursday.

12. B — next to
   à côté de means next to.

13. D — juin
   June in French is juin.

14. D — the fridge
   le frigo means the fridge.

15. A — la
   tête is feminine, so we say la tête.

SECTION B
----
16. (3 marks)
   Answer: la santé, le gâteau, les haricots
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct word with its accents and le or la.

17. (4 marks)
   Answer: le lit, la porte, la fenêtre, la chaise
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct label.

18. (3 marks)
   Answer: On Monday, I go to school.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for each correct part of the meaning: 3 marks in total.

19. (2 marks)
   Answer: Tournez à gauche.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for correct words, articles, accents and punctuation: 2 marks in total.

20. (3 marks)
   Answer: What is the weather like?
   Working / marking points: Award marks for each correct part of the meaning: 3 marks in total.
